worldcombat.skill.falsesurrender.summary: The user bows low as if conceding to draw the foe's attention away, then lashes its disheveled hair out of that lowest point straight under the guard: the strike starts low and sudden, so it cannot be dodged. The less the foe is watching the user, the harder it lands, at the cost of the user being unable to move while bowed.
worldcombat.skill.falsesurrender.descrip: The hair lash deals about %1$s damage, plus %2$s when the target is not attacking the user (the feint worked). Defence, type matchup and crit are settled on the hit.
The hair reaches a target within %1$s blocks, lashing out at %2$s blocks/tick with a %3$s block tip radius.
The bow takes %1$s s, during which the user cannot move; a hit drives the target back up to %3$s blocks and pins it in place for %2$s s (unable to move).
worldcombat.skill.falsesurrender.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
At level %1$s: lash power %2$s and hair reach %3$s blocks.
At level %1$s: lash power %2$s and ambush bonus %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.falsesurrender.use.0: Bow to feign surrender, then lash low
worldcombat.skill.falsesurrender.use.1: Land a heavier stab on a foe that is not watching
worldcombat.skill.falsesurrender.use.2: Come in under the guard from a low angle
worldcombat.skill.falsesurrender.prefere: On: bow deeper for about +15%% hair reach and about x1.25 ambush bonus, but the bow takes 4 ticks longer (longer exposure). Off: a shallower bow, faster and shorter exposure, but less reach and a smaller bonus.
Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of bowing. Larger values let it feint from further away.
On: a foe whose attention is elsewhere is preferred, which is where the feint pays; off: order it like a plain mid-range thrust.
On: the user may leave its post to get close; off: it only strikes from where it stands.
